verdict.rationale: Docs confirm JetBrains support (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand) with 'the same Cline experience' as VS Code, and GitHub docs explicitly state every edit shows as an interactive diff you can review, modify, or revert in both VS Code and JetBrains. Context sharing (e.g., referencing files/screenshots) is documented generally for Cline's core interface, implying it applies across supported editors. Missing for 10: JetBrains-specific screenshots/hands-on confirmation of diff UI and explicit JetBrains context-selection examples beyond general docs.
